title: Local torsion of a normalized algebraic dualizing complex is a residue-field injective hull
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], so $\mathfrak m$ is its unique maximal ideal, and put $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$. Let $\omega\in D(A)$ be an algebraic normalized dualizing complex [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. Set $\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(N)=\{x\in N:\mathfrak m^nx=0\text{ for some }n\geq1\}$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], and let $R\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}:D(A)\to D(A)$ be its unbounded right derived functor, computed by applying $\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}$ termwise to a K-injective representative [def-pur-kinjective-complex] on the one-object ringed site. Then $E_0=H^0(R\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(\omega))$ admits an injection $\kappa\hookrightarrow E_0$ making it an injective hull: $E_0$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every nonzero submodule of $E_0$ meets the image of $\kappa$ nontrivially. Moreover, $R\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(\omega)\cong E_0[0]$ in $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
